name: Filecab
description: Members fill out DOJ legal document templates via DM Q&A; finished documents are rendered and prepared for publishing to a GitHub Pages site, with an optional staff approve/deny gate.
author: emenblade
install_msg: Load with `[p]load filecab`, then run `[p]filecab setup` to configure.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores document filing answers and per-user filing state linked to Discord user IDs. Data can be deleted on request via `[p]mydata forgetme`.
